question: The annual average venture capital funding by year
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', date) AS year, SUM(venture_capital_funding) AS annual_avg_vc_funding FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE date >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', date) LIMIT 50;
